name: unikit-references
description: Keep your own reference material for the agents of this project in .unikit/references/ with an index: a local file or folder is copied word for word, a plain text or Markdown URL is downloaded as a copy, any other page is recorded as a link with a one-line note on when to read it. Nothing is summarised or rewritten. Use for "add this document as a reference", "save this link for the agents", "what references do we have", "remove that reference", "refresh the reference". Only your own sources; the folder .unikit/references/bridges/ of an earlier build is never touched or listed.
